programs.title: Zombie House Flipping: Family Business
programs.desc: Tommy Harr's brother Jake finds a wreck of a house on the outskirts of Columbus and brings Tommy in to partner on the deal; but on the first walkthrough, they discover major warning signs; the house is a disjointed mess, with a failed garage conversion, a broken layout, and a well system that might need to be replaced; they'll have to overcome an infestation of dangerous insects, and worst of all, a mind-boggling mess of mold and waste that rots in the basement.

programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: Seattle flipper James Dainard has tackled plenty of houses, and he loves the challenge of bringing the scariest zombie houses back from the brink of total destruction, but this one might be his worst yet. When he brings his team, construction manager Ryan and designer/realtor Megan, to check out the property, they think he can't be serious. The ramshackle house is rotting, packed with junk, buried in an overgrown yard, and looks like it could fall over with one strong push.
